full_judgment:
S.K. Sinha J: This petition for leave to appeal is directed from the judgment and order dated 12th August, 2010 of a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 18532 of 2010. 

 2. One Major (Retd.) Mohammad Hanif lodged an FIR with Gulshan Police Station against the respondent alleging, inter alia, that on 23rd February, 2010 at 22.10 hours some unknown miscreants threw 2(two) bombs aiming the office of Chairperson of BNP at Road No. 86, House No. 6, Gulshan-2. After the said incident 2(two) motor cycles were found to leave that place speedily. Leaders and workers of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party were running hither and thither when two workers sustained injuries due to explosion. The Party Workers present. there told that before the occurrence the member of Parliament and Whip of Ruling party Mr. Mirza Azam was found passing the front of the office of the Chairperson. In February, 2009 two bombs were recovered from the front of the said office. So the informant suspects that one group of miscreants is in conspiracy to endanger the life of the Chairperson. 

 3. In pursuance of the said FIR Gulshan P.S. Case No. 53 dated 24th February, 2010 under section 4 of the Explosive Substances Act was started. The respondent was arrested by the police on 28th February, 2010. After investigation police submitted charge sheet on 28th May, 2010 against 3 accused persons including the respondent under sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substances Act. 

 4. The respondent moved an application for bail before the Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Dhaka, who by his order dated 19th April, 2010 rejected the prayer for bail in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3303 of 2010. Thereafter the accused respondent moved the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.  18532 of 2010. A Division Bench of the High Court Division enlarged him on bail.
